jobs.title: Senior Procurement Specialist
jobs.description: ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. The Opportunity At ANYbotics, we build autonomous, end-to-end robotic solutions that automate routine industrial inspections in complex and hazardous environments. As a Senior Procurement Specialist , you will play a pivotal, high-ownership role in shaping the supply chain foundation for our next-generation robotics platform. Operating at the intersection of strategic sourcing and industrialization, you will drive critical procurement activities from early prototype phases straight through to full production ramp-up. You won't just be managing transactional purchase orders—you will build scalable procurement processes from scratch, secure high-performing global supplier networks, and directly influence the cost, quality, and delivery of cutting-edge robotic hardware. The Market & Our Technology Industrial facilities present some of the world's most severe operating conditions. Our autonomous quadrupedal platforms navigate multi-story plants, stairs, and hazardous areas—delivering continuous operational insight without human risk. Bringing a next-generation, high-complexity mechatronic product like ANYmal from concept to serial production demands a resilient, agile, and cost-effective supply chain. Sourcing high-precision mechanical parts, advanced electronics, and specialized electromechanical systems requires a strategic procurement leader who thrives in fast-paced hardware environments. Your Impact Establish and execute the end-to-end procurement strategy for the new ANYmal project across both prototype and production phases Secure critical suppliers and manage complex global sourcing networks across Europe and Asia Lead high-stakes RFQs, contract negotiations, and cost-optimization initiatives to meet ambitious target costs and timeline

jobs.description: Freelance Assignment 4 January to 30 April 2027 5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays) Reporting to COO The Challenge Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation. Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through. We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch. What You'll Do Keep things running Keep ops moving: Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks. Run verification: Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips.
